patterns.note: Full-bleed hero section featuring a single product image with overlayed text, setting a minimalist and product-focused tone.
Asymmetrical content sections often pair large product photography or imagery with concise text blocks, creating dynamic visual interest.
Extremely large, bold, sans-serif headings are used for section titles, contrasting with smaller, clean body text and uppercase labels.
A predominantly monochrome palette of white, light grey, and black is accented by metallic product finishes and a subtle golden hue for specific brand elements.
A sticky header containing the brand logo and hamburger menu remains fixed at the top of the viewport throughout scrolling.
Sections reveal their content with a staggered fade-up or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a smooth, guided scrolling experience.
The initial hero product image employs a subtle parallax effect, moving upwards and out of view as the user scrolls down the page.
Large, semi-transparent text elements are used as decorative background features that scroll with the page content, subtly identifying sections and adding visual depth.

technique_notes: A sticky header containing the brand logo and navigation toggle remains fixed at the top of the viewport.
The initial hero image employs a subtle parallax effect, moving upwards and out of view as the user scrolls down.
Sections are revealed using GSAP ScrollTrigger, where content elements (text, images, client lists) animate into view with a staggered fade-up or slide-up motion as they enter the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold sans-serif headings (up to ~4x body text) with smaller, uppercase labels and clean body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with no visible corner rounding on UI elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and content blocks, creating a sense of spaciousness.

standout: The distinctive use of oversized, semi-transparent background text as a scrolling, decorative element that subtly identifies content sections, combined with a minimalist aesthetic and high-quality product photography, creates a unique editorial feel.
